correctness.rationale: In the explicit Q example graph maps [u:v]->[u:v] and [u:v]->[-v^2:u^2+v^2] have degrees one and two and no base points. Their collision determinant u^3+uv^2+v^3 has dehomogenization t^3+t+1, no rational root, discriminant -31: one degree-3 closed Q-point splits into three reduced C-points. Inclusion-exclusion gives chi_c=chi(P1xP1)-chi(D)-chi(E)+chi(D∩E)=4-2-2+3=3, not 1 for A2. The general necessity follows by base change and chi_c equal to the number of geometric collision-support points; in char0 exactly one geometric point of a finite k-scheme must have k-rational reduction. The converse invokes the source ruled-surface/affine-bundle proof only when rationality allows descent of its centers. Independent exact polynomial factor/derivative/discriminant and Euler calculation corroborate the witness, not an independent check of the unavailable source entire converse.

value.rationale: A field-of-definition correction to a natural arbitrary-field affine-complement criterion matters whenever a single closed point has a nontrivial residue field. The irreducible cubic provides a concrete scheme-theoretic counterexample to the incorrect closed-point reading, with a useful geometric invariant obstruction.

final_claim: Over characteristic-zero k, the projective-bundle affine-space-complement criterion for two fibre hyperplane divisors requires |e-d|=1 and one k-rational geometric collision point. A single nonrational closed point is insufficient: the two graph divisors in P1_Q x P1_Q collide in an irreducible degree-three point but have complex complement Euler characteristic 3.
limitations: Characteristic-zero field; collision locus finite and expected hyperplane divisors.
